title: Gad
summary: Raleigh names Gad in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Gad the Prophet in Dauids time, named with Nathan and Samuel, who wrote Dauids storie and offered him the choice of three punishments. He is not Gad the sonne of Iacob. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVI, §. II, sig. 287a
